prompts.prompt: Deposit 100 USDC as collateral, borrow SOL at 2x leverage, farm it on Kamino, then simulate what happens to my health factor if SOL drops by 10%.
prompts.why: a price-shock scenario after the plan is a simulate read step; the transactions still go ahead

prompts.prompt: what happens to my health factor if SOL drops 30%?
prompts.why: a price shock is simulated on the protocol's maths

prompts.prompt: if I borrowed 100 USDC and SOL then fell 20%, would I be close to liquidation?
prompts.why: a hypothetical borrow plus a price move

prompts.prompt: how far can SOL fall before my account gets liquidated if I borrow 200 USDC?
prompts.why: the drop to liquidation after a hypothetical borrow

prompts.prompt: deposit 100 USDC as collateral and short SOL
prompts.why: the short is held back with the reason; the deposit goes ahead

prompts.prompt: supply 50 USDC and remind me tomorrow to check the APY
prompts.why: the reminder is held back; the supply goes ahead

prompts.prompt: sell 1 SOL when it hits 200 and supply 20 USDC
prompts.why: the conditional sale is never turned into a sale now; the supply goes ahead

prompts.prompt: when SOL drops below 100, sell 1 SOL
prompts.why: a message that is only a conditional order is still refused whole
